method: Real Codex in-app browser UI clicks, accessibility snapshots, screenshots, and read-only DOM inspection.

environment.input: Browser semantic controls and grid-cell buttons
environment.storage: Isolated port 18877 browser origin; original port 8877 saves were untouched.

conditions: S01 and S02 were completed with the existing 协同接管 UI, then all result story scenes were explicitly confirmed.
协同接管 did not count as a tactical first win; shared training points remained 0.
Only E01 / 林小禾 · 灯芽 was unlocked and used in the real browser; archive level and effective battle level were both 1.
No page-side application objects or localStorage were modified through evaluate; DOM inspection was read-only.

results.name: Lobby text navigation and main actions
results.evidence: Full named navigation and clear routes were visibly present at v1.3.1.

results.name: Joining story to actual deployment
results.evidence: S02 story handoff displayed E01 joining notice; S03 preflight recommended E01 and replaced infantry at (1,3), then E01 was present on the map.

results.name: Preflight names and steps
results.evidence: Selected name/callsign, original model and coordinates, effective level, active operation instructions, and unavailable aura/ultimate levels were visible.

results.name: Formal unlocked portrait qualification
results.evidence: Training roster and portrait modal contained E01-P01.webp loaded=true; the four locked characters and E01 P02/P03 rendered locked placeholders without image sources.

results.name: Formal face and battle sprite
results.evidence: Guide avatar E01.webp and selected portrait E01-P01.webp loaded=true; SVG map referenced E01-land-front.webp, and the independent chibi was visibly painted after E01 moved to (1,4).

results.name: First character guide and control visibility
results.evidence: Automatic E01 role/skill/cost instructions appeared after intro confirmation; focus selected E01. Coach was repositioned away from desktop selected-unit buttons.

results.name: Individual ordinary character guidance
results.evidence: Acknowledging E01 advanced to scout 游隼 and then engineer 织补; acknowledging the final card returned to direct commands.

results.name: Full skill detail and repeat reading
results.evidence: Full detail displayed role, frozen levels, actual stats, action instructions, active/aura/ultimate descriptions and unlock levels. After acknowledging E01, its details still opened the teaching modal.

results.name: Actual character movement
results.evidence: A direct move from (1,3) to (1,4) consumed one AP, leaving AP1 and energy34. Formal chibi remained visible.

results.name: Actual named active skill
results.evidence: Clicked 灯芽信标 then visible land cell (2,4). AP became0; energy remained34; status drawer showed charge20/100 and the configured 0energy, cooldown2-own-turn description.

results.name: Final console warnings/errors
results.evidence: The final browser dev log read returned [] for error/warn levels.

limitations: Real browser paint and interaction coverage is desktop E01 / Lv1 only.
No phone hardware, physical touch input, sound output, other elite skills, high-level battle skills, or full campaign tactical completion is claimed.

Other heroes, all 38 ordinary models, high-level first appearance, P2 viewer restoration and engineer AP wording are covered by the separate isolated controller/VM regression report, not this browser record.
note: The later review corrected engineer instruction wording, added all-open-skill descriptions to first cards, and current-viewer ownership. These targeted controller cases passed 14/14; the screenshots demonstrate the desktop Lv1 E01 workflow.
